_meta.description: Greedy bracket-timestamp transcription converted to TXT, JSON, and SRT output.

settings.user_prompt: Transcribe the {{SOURCE_LANGUAGE}} speech verbatim and divide it into short subtitle cues. Output exactly one cue per line in the form [MM:SS-MM:SS] text, using the audible start and end time and continuing to HH:MM:SS when the recording exceeds one hour. Keep each cue readable, preserve speech order and wording, add only necessary punctuation, use [inaudible] for unclear speech, and output no heading, explanation, or code fence.
